{"id":1675399877,"question_id":13,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year","timestamp":1750802846,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1675399877/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Roman to Integer","memory":"10.2 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int romanToInt(string s) {\n        int val=0;\n        for(int i=0;i<s.length();i++){\n            if(s[i]=='I'){\n                if(s[i+1]=='V'){\n                    val+=4;\n                    i++;\n                }\n                else if(s[i+1]=='X'){\n                    val+=9;\n                    i++;\n                }\n                else{\n                    val+=1;\n                }\n            }\n            else if(s[i]=='X'){\n                if(s[i+1]=='L'){\n                    val+=40;\n                    i++;\n                }\n                else if(s[i+1]=='C'){\n                    val+=90;\n                    i++;\n                }\n                else{\n                    val+=10;\n                }\n            }\n            else if(s[i]=='C'){\n                if(s[i+1]=='D'){\n                    val+=400;\n                    i++;\n                }\n                else if(s[i+1]=='M'){\n                    val+=900;\n                    i++;\n                }\n                else{\n                    val+=100;\n                }\n            }\n            else if(s[i]=='V'){\n                val+=5;}\n            else if(s[i]=='L'){\n                val+=50;}\n            else if(s[i]=='D'){\n                val+=500;}\n            else if(s[i]=='M'){\n                val+=1000;}\n        }\n        return val;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"roman-to-integer","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":683}
